The State Controller FY2023-24 Expenditures Supplement is a broader budgetary/legal-basis source than the FI$Cal vendor subset. It covers numeric current-year net expenditures by business unit and appropriation, preserves sourceAmount, and is used as the single primary pie layer. The census fy2024 state-finance comparator is retained for comparison only; its lower total is not assigned to a receiver or program.
